experience.description: Player-experience targets read by Scripts/balance-scan.py (designer answers 2026-10-26; see Documentation/EXPERIENCE_HARNESS_DESIGN.md). Command-line flags override these.
experience.classSignatureWhy: Each class plays to its primary attribute: Mace/STR scales damage (hit size), Sword/AGI swing speed (tempo: hero swings per enemy swing), Dagger/TEC lowers hit/combo/crit thresholds (crit share), Wand/INT the combo amplifier (combo lift: combo hit damage over plain hit damage).
